signals.name: Peak heatwave, North-West plains
signals.items: ACs, air coolers, fans, fridges, inverters, cotton wear, sunscreen, cold drinks, ORS
signals.reason: IMD core heatwave zone; heatwaves Mar-Jun peaking in May, ending with the late-June monsoon

signals.name: Peak heat, Central India
signals.items: ACs, coolers, fans, fridges, inverters, sunscreen, cotton wear, beverages
signals.reason: MP, CG and Vidarbha in IMD's core heatwave zone (peak May); Gujarat peaks Apr-May

signals.name: Heatwave, Deccan & East Coast
signals.items: ACs, coolers, fans, fridges, inverters, sunscreen, cold drinks
signals.reason: Telangana, coastal AP and Odisha in IMD's core heatwave zone; peak May until mid-June monsoon

signals.name: Humid summer, East Gangetic plains
signals.items: fans, coolers, ACs, inverters, fridges, prickly-heat powder, beverages
signals.reason: Bihar, Jharkhand and Gangetic WB in IMD's Apr-Jun heatwave zone; humid pre-monsoon heat

signals.name: Early summer heat, South
signals.items: fans, ACs, fridges, sunscreen, cotton wear, beverages
signals.reason: Peninsular and coastal heat peaks Mar-May before the 1 June Kerala onset; humid rather than extreme (estimate)

signals.name: Online AC & fridge summer surge
signals.items: split and window ACs, refrigerators, coolers on EMI with installation
signals.reason: Amazon saw AC demand triple and Flipkart 4x in early summer; heatwave years drive Apr-Jun spikes

signals.name: Mild hill summer
signals.items: light jackets, trekking shoes, fans, travel gear (ACs rarely needed)
signals.reason: Hills stay cool, so demand leans to travel and light layers rather than ACs (estimate)

signals.name: Ladakh short summer
signals.items: high-SPF sunscreen, sunglasses, trekking and biking gear, thermal layers
signals.reason: Cold desert open to road traffic Jun-Sep; strong UV, no cooling demand (estimate)

signals.name: Monsoon arrives, Andamans
signals.items: umbrellas, raincoats, waterproof footwear, mosquito repellent
signals.reason: SW monsoon reaches the Andaman Sea ~20-22 May, ahead of the mainland (estimate)

signals.name: Monsoon arrives, Kerala
signals.items: umbrellas, raincoats, gumboots, mosquito repellent, waterproofing
signals.reason: IMD normal monsoon onset over Kerala is 1 June

signals.name: Monsoon, Karnataka coast & Goa
signals.items: umbrellas, raincoats, gumboots, dehumidifiers, anti-fungal care, roof waterproofing
signals.reason: Onset early June (Goa ~7 Jun, Bengaluru ~5 Jun, estimate); very heavy Jun-Sep rain on the coast

signals.name: Monsoon, Mumbai & Maharashtra
signals.items: umbrellas, raincoats, waterproof footwear, phone pouches, bike and car covers, repellents
signals.reason: IMD normal onset for Mumbai is 11 June; Konkan rain heaviest Jul-Aug

signals.name: Monsoon, Telangana, AP & TN (southwest)
signals.items: umbrellas, raincoats, mosquito repellent (TN gets only light SW rain)
signals.reason: SW onset early-mid June (Hyderabad ~8 Jun, estimate); TN's main rain comes later from the NE monsoon

signals.name: Monsoon, Northeast
signals.items: umbrellas, raincoats, gumboots, repellents, dehumidifiers, tarpaulins
signals.reason: Monsoon reaches the NE in early June (~5-10 Jun, estimate); Meghalaya is among the world's wettest regions

signals.name: Monsoon, Kolkata & the East
signals.items: umbrellas, raincoats, waterproof sandals, mosquito nets, waterproofing
signals.reason: Normal onset ~mid June (Kolkata/Bhubaneswar ~11 Jun, Patna/Ranchi/Raipur ~13 Jun, estimate)

signals.name: Monsoon, Central & North India
signals.items: umbrellas, raincoats, repellents, kharif seeds and agri inputs
signals.reason: Onset mid-late June (Bhopal ~16, Lucknow ~18, Ahmedabad ~19, Dehradun/Shimla ~22 Jun; estimate)

signals.name: Monsoon, Delhi & Punjab-Haryana
signals.items: umbrellas, raincoats, repellents, dehumidifiers, waterproofing
signals.reason: IMD normal onset over Delhi is 27 June; main rain Jul-Aug (humid heat keeps AC demand on)

signals.name: Monsoon, Rajasthan & J&K
signals.items: umbrellas, repellents, agri inputs
signals.reason: Monsoon covers all of India by the 8 July normal date; modest rain in J&K (estimate)

signals.name: Monsoon quick-commerce essentials
signals.items: umbrellas and raincoats (up to 5x), mop and cleaning sets (2.5x)
signals.reason: Flipkart Minutes: one in five June orders had a monsoon product, led by Delhi, Bengaluru, Mumbai

signals.name: Monsoon withdraws, North-West
signals.items: rainwear demand tails off
signals.reason: Withdrawal starts in west Rajasthan ~17 Sep and leaves Delhi ~25 Sep (estimate)

signals.name: Northeast monsoon, Tamil Nadu
signals.items: umbrellas, raincoats, waterproof footwear, repellents, inverters, waterproofing
signals.reason: Normal NE monsoon onset over coastal TN is 20 Oct; Oct-Dec brings ~48% of TN's annual rain

signals.name: Late-season rain, Kerala & Karnataka
signals.items: umbrellas, raincoats, repellents
signals.reason: NE-monsoon thundershowers in Oct-Nov in south Karnataka and Kerala (estimate)

signals.name: Bay of Bengal cyclone season
signals.items: discretionary spend dips at landfall; power banks, inverters, torches and staples rise
signals.reason: IMD: Oct-Nov is the peak cyclone season; over 58% of Bay landfalls (Phailin, Hudhud)

signals.name: Pre-monsoon cyclone risk
signals.items: short dips at landfall; power backup and emergency lights rise
signals.reason: May is the secondary cyclone peak (Fani, Amphan); occasional Arabian Sea storms (estimate)

signals.name: Assam & Northeast floods
signals.items: discretionary dips and delivery disruption; staples, power backup, medicines, tarpaulins rise
signals.reason: ASDMA reports repeated Brahmaputra flood waves Jun-Sep (2026 toll passed 100)

signals.name: North Bihar floods
signals.items: discretionary dips; staples, emergency lights, medicines, rebuilding rise
signals.reason: 2026 Bihar floods hit ~22 lakh people in 14 districts (Kosi/Gandak; east UP too, estimate)

signals.name: Hill floods & landslides
signals.items: tourism and discretionary spend dip; power banks, rainwear, essentials rise
signals.reason: Cloudbursts and landslides peak Jul-Aug in the Himalaya and Western Ghats (estimate)

signals.name: Delhi-NCR pollution season
signals.items: air purifiers, HEPA filters, N95 masks, nasal and throat care
signals.reason: Stubble burning and Diwali push AQI to severe; purifier sales rise 50-70% in Oct-Nov

signals.name: Wider North India smog
signals.items: N95 masks, budget air purifiers
signals.reason: Winter inversions worsen Indo-Gangetic AQI beyond NCR (estimate)

signals.name: North Indian winter & cold waves
signals.items: room heaters, oil radiators, geysers, woollens, jackets, blankets, moisturisers
signals.reason: Cold waves doubled room-heater demand; Flipkart heating demand +33% Oct-Dec incl. Patna, Lucknow, Gaya

signals.name: Severe Himalayan winter
signals.items: heaters, geysers, thermals, down jackets, snow boots, heated blankets, cold cream
signals.reason: Sub-zero months in J&K and Ladakh (Chillai Kalan Dec-Jan); long heating season (estimate)

signals.name: Mild winter, East & West
signals.items: light woollens, shawls, blankets, geysers, moisturisers; NE hills need heaters
signals.reason: Short cool season Dec-Feb; NE hills cold at night, plains need light layers (estimate)

signals.name: Warm winter, South & islands
signals.items: moisturisers, light jackets (Bengaluru/Hyderabad nights), beach travel
signals.reason: Little heating need; dry-skin care and peak tourist season Dec-Jan (estimate)

signals.name: Dengue & malaria season
signals.items: mosquito repellents and coils, nets, fever meds, thermometers, ORS
signals.reason: Dengue peaks Jul-Nov, usually Sep-Oct; endemic in all states except Ladakh

signals.name: Vector-borne disease, South & NE
signals.items: repellents, nets, fever and flu meds, test kits
signals.reason: South India has no single dengue peak (4 of 5 southern states peaked in July 2026); NE malaria peaks in monsoon

signals.name: Monsoon safety & hygiene buying
signals.items: repellents, disinfectants, bike and car covers, anti-skid mats
signals.reason: Snapdeal saw safety-related monsoon products grow multi-fold

signals.name: Winter flu & cold season
signals.items: cough and cold remedies, vaporisers, humidifiers, immunity supplements, kids' winter care
signals.reason: Cold and smog in Dec-Feb bring respiratory infections in the North (estimate)
